name: Ouroboros
description: Six listed companies that are, underneath the filings, leveraged positions on the same thing you are paying with. Circle issues USDC and earns the interest on its reserves. Strategy is a bitcoin holding company with a software segment attached. Coinbase and Robinhood are the toll booths. Deposit SOL to mint ouroSOL, burn it back for SOL at NAV any time. Holdings: COIN, CRCL, HOOD, MSTR, STRC, GME. Solana deployment by Copycat. Not an ETF, not a registered fund, not investment advice.
